captions.detailed: A commercial kitchen exhaust box fan featuring a square-profile housing in grey metal with black corner brackets. On the back face, a backward-curved six-blade impeller is mounted behind a circular wire safety guard supported by four rectangular corner brackets. On the right-hand side panel, a raised square plate holds a black three-position dial knob. The impeller rotates continuously on a central axis, and the dial knob rotates on a revolute joint to select the fan speed.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a commercial kitchen exhaust box fan. The model must include a square metal housing with black corner accents, a six-blade backward-curved impeller on a continuous revolute joint, a circular wire safety guard, and a three-position speed control dial knob on a revolute joint on the side panel.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing using box primitives combined and subtracted to form the hollow casing and side plate. Create the wire guard by sweep-extruding circular paths and radial spokes, then positioning four mounting blocks at the cardinal directions. Model the impeller with a central cylinder hub and six curved blades generated through helical or polar-patterned extrusions. Create the control knob as a cylinder with fluted ridges, and assemble all components using an ArticulatedObject structure with continuous joints for the impeller and limited revolute joints for the control knob.
